paragraphs: New Way Trucks builds refuse trucks in a range of sizes and models. Each build can be customized to the customer's team. Parts and service experts work with customers to keep a fleet maintained and ready to roll.

Manufacturing facilities are in Iowa and Mississippi, and the company states that it serves fleets in all 50 states, plus Canada, Latin America, and more. Distributors across North America provide support to those fleets. New Way Trucks is a Federal Signal Corporation company.

The pages describe solid waste haulers as the operators these trucks are built for. One blog post names distributors, private and public waste haulers, and municipal sanitation departments among the groups the company works closely with. Refuse collection equipment can also be procured through Sourcewell contracts.

quote.text: We build the trucks you want, in the size you need, with the features that keep you moving efficiently and safely.
